snippet.title: OMSI 2: Project Numazu – Official FYC Trailer | The Game Awards 2026 (4K)
snippet.description:
Bus Simulator OMSI 2 – Project Numazu Official Extension & FYC Showcase.

Submitted for Consideration in The Game Awards 2026:
🏆 Best Sim/ Strategy

Developed by Hong Kong indie studio Aurora Studio in collaboration with Negi-Kyu Vehicle Studio and published by Aerosoft , "Project Numazu" brings a highly precise 1:1 scale digital twin of Numazu City, Japan to world-renowned bus simulator OMSI 2.

--------------------------------------------------
✨ Key Features:
• 1:1 Scale Recreation: Over 15 miles of authentic urban, coastal, and mountain routes across Numazu & Izunagaoka.
• Authentic Japanese Bus Systems: Fully functional RHD controls, dynamic ticket issuers, fare matrix displays, and custom door/engine mechanics.
• Living Environment: Dynamic weather, day/night cycles, and iconic local landmarks including the Byuo Water Gate and Suruga Bay.
• Cultural Authenticity: Officially recognized and featured by the Numazu City Tourism Division.

--------------------------------------------------
🏛️ Recognition & Milestones:
• ACM SIGGRAPH Asia 2025 Games Program Exhibition Presenter
• Tokyo Game Show 2025 (German Pavilion with Aerosoft)
• HKGD GCE 2024 Excellence Award Winner
• Featured on 4Gamer.net, GNN, and official Numazu Tourism Portal
• Global Reach & Community Engagement: Featured in high-profile streaming events 
(including hololive, AlfoMask, JayGameplay), 
engaging over 500,000+ simulation enthusiasts worldwide.

--------------------------------------------------
🛒 Available now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3880120/OMSI_2_Addon_Project_Numazu/

🌐 Official Website & Press Kit:
https://aurora-studio.org

#OMSI2 #ProjectNumazu #TheGameAwards #TGA2026 #BusSimulator #Aerosoft #AuroraStudio #IndieDev
